title: Update: Just reached 100 users for my image gen project - FormFromLight
author: Witty-Tangerine3606
selftext:
I built FormFromLight couple of weeks ago and the amount of love it has gotten is insane can't believe it I am so happy. Just reached 100 users in a couple of weeks and hopefully more awaits. I saw some big gaming companies use it aswell which is really cool to see.

With this project you are able to generate 2d image to 3d models, full asset kits with lots of models in one go based on an image you upload. I looked at my competitors and exports of the models are behind a paywall mine is not, and you get free generations after creating an account for the first time! (Pls do not abuse it :p)

You are also able to generate 2d image to 3d worlds which you can export into an game engine. It does not stop there! I also added MCP and API support you are able to install my MCP to codex so you can generate high quality assets while it codes your whole game. 

There are examples on the website of the generation results. I will soon upload a video soon how to make a game with my MCP.
